scope: Named source zones and geometric building candidates; no facade or interior survey.

buildingSource.geometryUsed: Original atlas coordinates; an XY-only analysis copy is projected for overlap calculations.

method.centroidMinimumBoundaryDistance: strictly greater than declared zone planimetric accuracy
method.acceptance: A unique dominant building covering at least90% of the zone, or a source religious building in a source religious site. Context membership never identifies every component as the central monument.
method.buildingCandidateRule: Source building intersects source zone with projected intersection area at least 0.01 square metres.
method.deduplication: Repeated atlas feature copies deduplicated by sourceId.
method.projection: EPSG:4326 to EPSG:2154 using rasterio.warp.transform; Shapely polygon intersection and geometric centroid.
method.centroidTest: Zone covers the area centroid of the whole source building polygon, including multipart geometry and holes.
method.reportedRounding: Areas to 0.001 square metre; centroid boundary distances to 0.000001 metre. These are calculation digits, not measurement accuracy.
method.fictifMeaning: Fictitious source zone geometry; it does not mean that the named place is imaginary.

limitations: Site name/use only; not a facade survey, room plan, opening annotation or central-monument identity.
A religious site can consist of several separate IGN building volumes. These records retain each original source identity.
Zones with fictitious geometry or declared accuracy above3m are excluded from these strict automatic-link proposals.
Area and overlap figures are computed from source polygons, not new physical measurements.
The query is limited to selected name fragments and the municipal bounding box, not every named place in Marseille.
The bounding box includes neighbouring communes; the Cour d’Honneur de l’Hôtel de Ville returned by this query is in LA PENNE-SUR-HUVEAUNE.
A site name is not the individual architectural identity of every intersecting building.
The 12 selected records are a strict proposal for site context only; no facadeDocument or interiorDocument is supplied.
